mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_like (user_id, comment_id, like_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{commentId}, now())
INSERT INTO post_like (post_id, user_id, like_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, now())
INSERT INTO post_like_count (post_id, like_count) VALUES (#{postId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE post_id = post_id
INSERT INTO comment_like_count (comment_id, like_count) VALUES (#{commentId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_id = comment_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
